subject: Sprint sync: feature launch protocol & JSON gating
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@novomed.com>, Aaron Holt <aaron.holt@novomed.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Sprint sync: feature launch protocol & JSON gating

Hi Elena / Aaron —

Appreciate the time yesterday. Quick note to align on the implementation plan for the streaming + tool-calling feature set and the structured output (JSON) gate we'll use for go/no-go. High level ask:

- Proposed cutover window: 2027-05-03 to 2027-05-07 (low-traffic period)
- We will deliver a v1 JSON schema and a short validation tool for your engineering team to run locally by 2027-04-20
- Redwood will own runtime config (batching/kv-cache) and initial A/B rollback policy; Novomed to confirm acceptance criteria for structured outputs (sample prompts & golden responses)

Could you confirm the procurement contact for SOW/PO so we can schedule DocuSign and the preferred SLA amendment window?

Attached: initial schema stub (novomed_feature_schema_v1.json).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
[attachment: novomed_feature_schema_v1.json (application/json)]

From: Elena Park <elena@novomed.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: Aaron Holt <aaron.holt@novomed.com>
Date: 2027-04-15T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sprint sync: feature launch protocol & JSON gating

Thanks Soojin — this looks good. Quick answers: 

- Confirmed cutover window works for us but we'd prefer final confirmation by 2027-04-25 after we've had time to vet the schema.
- Procurement contact is Aaron Holt (cc'd). Aaron will handle the SOW + PO cadence; Aaron, please advise on expected turnaround on our side.
- Engineering ask: can you include a compact sample schema plus one example of a streaming payload and the expected validated JSON output? Our backend team wants to run the validator against their staging payloads.

I'll pull in our platform engineer if needed — for now, please send the schema + a 2–3 line validator README.

Best,
Elena Park
Director of Engineering, Novomed Health

Date: 2027-04-16T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sprint sync: feature launch protocol & JSON gating — internal ops

Internal ops notes (assignments + deliverables):

- Deliverables by 2027-04-20:
  1) novomed_feature_schema_v1.json (Soojin / Camila)
  2) validator README + sample payloads (Camila)
  3) Implementation responsibility matrix (attached) — Marcus to fill runtime knobs, Naomi to own observability/dashboards

- Marcus: will you draft the runtime config doc (autoscale thresholds, batching/cold-start notes) by 2027-04-19?
- Naomi: please stub the per-route latency and error dashboards and a token-cost breakdown template by 2027-04-19 so we can demo on the 4/22 internal walkthrough.

I've attached the responsibility matrix for you both to fill out. Keep it tight — we want a 2-week runway to SOW sign + schema acceptance.

Thanks — I'll coordinate the internal walkthrough invite once we have the schema v1.

Camila Reyes
Director, Customer Success — Onboarding
Redwood Inference
[attachment: implementation-responsibility-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@novomed.com>, Aaron Holt <aaron.holt@novomed.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-17T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sprint sync: feature launch protocol & JSON gating — schema v1 & next steps

Elena / Aaron —

Per request, attached is the first-pass schema (novomed_feature_schema_v1.json) plus a short validator README and an onboarding checklist. Highlights:

- Schema excerpt (required fields):
  {
    "session_id": "string",
    "events": [
      {
        "type": "string",
        "timestamp": "iso-8601",
        "payload": {
          "intent": "string",
          "entities": [ {"name": "string", "value": "string"} ]
        }
      }
    ]
  }

- Validator README includes a Node script and sample curl command for streaming payloads.
- Next milestones:
  * 2027-04-20: schema v1 acceptance window opens (Novomed review)
  * 2027-04-25: final sign-off date for cutover planning
  * 2027-05-03 to 05-07: proposed cutover window (subject to sign-off)

Aaron — can you confirm procurement timing so we can lock the SOW and schedule DocuSign?

Thanks all — looping Camila to schedule the 4/22 walkthrough and the internal readiness demo.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
[attachment: novomed_feature_schema_v1.json (application/json)] [attachment: onboarding-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)]
